items.exampleEn: Builders wear helmets to protect their heads.
items.exampleZh: 建築工人戴安全帽保護頭部。

items.exampleEn: She keeps her keys in her purse.
There is a small hole in my left sleeve.
items.exampleZh: 我左邊的袖子上有一個小洞。

items.exampleEn: This shop sells garments made of cotton.
A scarf is a nice accessory for winter.
items.exampleZh: 圍巾是冬天很好的配件。

items.exampleEn: She wore a gold necklace to the party.
items.exampleZh: 她戴了一條金項鍊去參加派對。

items.exampleEn: He looked at his wristwatch and started to run.
items.exampleZh: 他看了一眼手錶，就開始跑了起來。

items.exampleEn: The runner is tall and lean.

items.sentenceEn: I lost my purse on the bus this morning.
items.sentenceZh: 我今天早上在公車上弄丟了錢包。

items.audioEn: This necklace costs fifty dollars, but the bracelet is only twenty.
items.audioZh: 這條項鍊五十元，但手環只要二十元。

items.sentenceEn: Roll up your sleeves before you wash the dishes.
items.sentenceZh: 洗碗前先把袖子捲起來。

items.sentenceEn: She chose a few small accessories to go with her black dress.
items.sentenceZh: 她挑了幾件小配件來搭配黑色洋裝。

items.stemEn: You must wear a ____ when you ride a bike in this city.
items.stemZh: 在這座城市騎腳踏車必須戴安全帽。

items.stemEn: Wash this ____ in cold water so it keeps its size.
items.stemZh: 這件衣服要用冷水洗，才不會縮水。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I helped my aunt clean out her old wardrobe. Inside, we found many garments from forty years ago, including a dress with very long sleeves. We also found a box of accessories: a gold necklace, an old purse, and a wristwatch that still worked. My aunt said each object had a unique story. She was young and lean back then, so none of the clothes fit her now! In the end, she gave me the wristwatch, and I wear it every day.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我幫阿姨整理她的舊衣櫃。我們在裡面找到很多四十年前的衣服，包括一件袖子很長的洋裝。我們還找到一盒配件：一條金項鍊、一個舊錢包，還有一支還會走的手錶。阿姨說每樣東西都有獨特的故事。她那時又年輕又瘦，所以現在那些衣服都穿不下了！最後，她把手錶送給我，我每天都戴著。

questions.questionZh: 作者和阿姨在盒子裡找到什麼？
阿姨為什麼穿不下那些衣服？

items.promptZh: 這條項鍊是我媽媽送我的禮物。
referenceEn: This necklace was a gift from my mother.
My mother gave me this necklace as a gift.
rubricZh: 「送我的禮物」可寫 a gift from…、gave me… as a gift 等
時態配合內容（例如 was、gave、is）

items.instructionZh: 用 accessory 造一個句子，說說你最常戴或用的配件。
referenceEn: My favorite accessory is a simple silver ring.
I usually wear a watch as my only accessory.
rubricZh: accessory 表示「配件、飾品」，是可數名詞
說的是自己的東西或習慣（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
